description: What a model's names and declaration add (pack.ModelCheck.check: checkDrawn's hinge markers, checkGroups, checkAnimations, checkLiveries): untextured hinge markers, control groups too long to send, .anim files, liveries. At most one animation and one livery per case finds something: the engine keeps them by Map.copyOf, in no set order. input: namespace (the declaring file's, for unqualified paths), declaration (the wagon model's JSON), files (ns:path -> text), present (locations that are there, contents unread: textures); any other key with a colon is a file too (what input_file reads of the example pack). A location is valid as Minecraft takes it: [a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9/._-]+. expected: the problems in the check's order, each {severity: error | warning, finding}; the engine gives only the finding's text yet (code, subject, index null, params {}).
